operative_clauses.original_operative_text: A dispute exists between the Port Authority Trans-Hudson Corporation and the Brotherhood of Railroad Signalmen representing employees of the Port Authority Trans-Hudson Corporation.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 261344; common-crawl capture 2026-01-15T12:12:12Z; operative words before the numbered sections

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: The dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended ("the Act").

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 261344; common-crawl capture 2026-01-15T12:12:12Z; operative words before the numbered sections

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: A party empowered by the Act has requested that the President establish an emergency board pursuant to Section 9A of the Act.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 261344; common-crawl capture 2026-01-15T12:12:12Z; operative words before the numbered sections

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: Section 9A(e) of the Act provides that the President, upon such a request, shall appoint an emergency board to investigate and report on the dispute.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 261344; common-crawl capture 2026-01-15T12:12:12Z; operative words before the numbered sections

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: Section 1. Establishment of Board. There is hereby established a board of three members to be appointed by the President to investigate this dispute. No member shall be pecuniarily or otherwise interested in any organization of railroad employees or any carrier. The board shall perform its functions subject to the availability of funds.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 261344; common-crawl capture 2026-01-15T12:12:12Z; Sec. 1

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) Within 30 days from the creation of the board, the parties to the dispute shall submit to the board final offers for settlement of the dispute.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 261344; common-crawl capture 2026-01-15T12:12:12Z; Sec. 2(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) Within 30 days after submission of final offers for settlement of the dispute, the board shall submit a report to the President setting forth its selection of the most reasonable offer.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 261344; common-crawl capture 2026-01-15T12:12:12Z; Sec. 2(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: Sec. 3. Maintaining Conditions. As provided by Section 9A(h) of the Act, as amended, from the time a request to establish a board is made until 60 days after the board makes its report, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the parties in the conditions out of which the dispute arose.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 261344; common-crawl capture 2026-01-15T12:12:12Z; Sec. 3

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: Sec. 4. Expiration. The board shall terminate upon the submission of the report provided for in Section 2 of this Order.
